name: Cart & Checkout Analytics core scenarios
description: Real Cart & Checkout Analytics Q&A pairs grounded in synthetic seed data: digital funnel conversion, cart abandonment revenue loss, payment gateway decline exceptions, and checkout industry benchmarks.

parts.text: What is the checkout conversion rate by device type over the past two weeks?

Over the 15-day period ending July 24, 2026, checkout conversion rates by device type are: Mobile App leads at 25.00% (2,375 orders / 9,500 sessions), Desktop follows at 15.50% (1,860 orders / 12,000 sessions), Tablet at 11.00% (242 orders / 2,200 sessions), and Mobile Web trails at 6.00% (1,110 orders / 18,500 sessions).
Which checkout stage experiences the highest abandoned revenue dollars and what is the primary exit reason?

The Shipping Information stage accounts for the highest abandoned revenue at $189,000.00 (2,100 abandoned carts, 41.2% abandonment rate), with 'Unexpected Shipping Costs' identified as the primary exit reason. Payment Info follows with $159,600.00 in abandoned revenue (35.8% rate).
Which payment gateway is currently showing an abnormal decline rate and what is the associated error code?

PayPal is exhibiting an elevated decline rate of 35.00% (2,975 failed transactions out of 8,500 total), driven by error code ERR_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT. Other gateways operate normally: Adyen (2.50%), Apple Pay (2.00%), Stripe (3.00%), and Klarna (4.00%).
How do our mobile checkout conversion rates compare to e-commerce industry benchmarks?

E-commerce industry benchmarks for mobile checkout conversion range from 2.0% – 3.5% for Mobile Web and 4.0% – 6.0% for Mobile Apps. Our Mobile App conversion rate of 25.00% significantly outperforms industry averages, while Mobile Web at 6.00% also beats standard benchmarks.
